adjudication.rationale: The diff shows two separate validations that already diverge: the client dialog defines a local `ZAddGuestsInputSchema = z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)` enforcing uniqueness (`AddGuestsDialog.tsx`), while the server endpoint input schema (`addGuests.schema.ts`) only enforces `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness constraint. Because the server handler also does not dedupe within the submitted `guests` list (it filters only against existing attendees / blacklist), a caller can submit duplicate emails and potentially create duplicate attendee records / send duplicate notifications, while the UI would block it. This is a real, diff-grounded inconsistency/validation defect.
